% Coexistence probe for the v3 generic-API contraction (issue 84).
%
% Loads the established packages that own the marquee colliding names --
% siunitx (\unit) and doc (\meta) -- BEFORE lanepaper, then asserts lanepaper
% leaves their definitions untouched and restores standard LaTeX / amsmath
% meanings. Bare checks confirm the other removed helpers are undefined.
%
% RED before #84 (lanepaper's \newcommand{\unit}/{\meta} clashed with the
% established packages, and its renews changed standard commands); GREEN after.
\documentclass[11pt]{article}

\usepackage{amsmath}
\usepackage{siunitx}   % owns \unit
\usepackage{doc}       % owns \meta

% Capture established-package and standard meanings BEFORE lanepaper loads.
\let\lnpprobeunit\unit
\let\lnpprobemeta\meta
\let\lnpprobecode\code
\let\lnpprobethinspace\thinspace
\let\lnpprobemedspace\medspace
\let\lnpprobethickspace\thickspace
\let\lnpprobeS\S
\let\lnpprobeP\P
\let\lnpprobecopyright\copyright
\let\lnpprobedag\dag
\let\lnpprobeddag\ddag

\usepackage{lanepaper}

\makeatletter
% (a) Established-package and standard commands are left untouched by lanepaper.
\def\lnpprobe@same#1#2{%
  \ifx#1#2\else
    \PackageError{coexistence}{A command owned elsewhere was changed by lanepaper}%
      {The v3 contraction (issue 84) must not redefine it.}%
  \fi}
\lnpprobe@same\lnpprobeunit\unit%       siunitx keeps \unit
\lnpprobe@same\lnpprobemeta\meta%       doc keeps \meta
\lnpprobe@same\lnpprobecode\code%       doc keeps \code
\lnpprobe@same\lnpprobethinspace\thinspace
\lnpprobe@same\lnpprobemedspace\medspace
\lnpprobe@same\lnpprobethickspace\thickspace
\lnpprobe@same\lnpprobeS\S
\lnpprobe@same\lnpprobeP\P
\lnpprobe@same\lnpprobecopyright\copyright
\lnpprobe@same\lnpprobedag\dag
\lnpprobe@same\lnpprobeddag\ddag

% (b) The other removed generic helpers are undefined by lanepaper.
\def\lnpprobe@gone#1{%
  \@ifundefined{#1}{}{%
    \PackageError{coexistence}{Macro #1 is still defined by lanepaper}%
      {The v3 contraction (issue 84) must remove this generic macro.}}%
}
\lnpprobe@gone{strongemph}%
\lnpprobe@gone{critical}%
\lnpprobe@gone{semantic}%
\lnpprobe@gone{emdash}%
\lnpprobe@gone{euro}%
\lnpprobe@gone{half}%
\lnpprobe@gone{real}%
\lnpprobe@gone{norm}%
\lnpprobe@gone{refpage}%
\lnpprobe@gone{seealso}%
\lnpprobe@gone{titlesc}%   the retained small caps is private now, not public
\makeatother

\begin{document}
Coexistence holds: \unit{\meter} and \meta{arg}, with standard
\S1, \P2, \copyright, \dag, \ddag, \dots.
\end{document}
